text.tspan: "Driver needs emergency braking assistance to avoid or mitigate a rear-end collision with a forward vehicle target."
"The subject vehicle approaches a forward vehicle target with a collision risk that exceeds the intervention threshold."
"The driver is warned and, absent a decisive override, emergency braking is commanded to mitigate the collision risk."
Establish the operational story for vehicle-target forward
collision risk mitigation in the AEBS pilot. This use case
frames the operational context only; requirements, functional
interfaces, VSS signal candidates, conceptual realization,
